notes.title: CUBIA is available in the Steam Autumn Game Festival!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=oDbwEBl-P_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

CUBIA, the award-winning unique 3D puzzle game, is available to the public for the first time in the Steam autumn Game Festival! 

In CUBIA, guide Rolland in his quest to solve the mystery of his home planet, where the ground rotates under your feet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38628671/f5f0df48fe5209715770a852381b45dfc15ff269.gif[/img]

Play the [b]free demo[/b] and set foot into the mystical world of CUBIA today. 

Cubia free demo teases the unique puzzle style of the game while letting you explore and experience challenging puzzles from different lands of Cubia.

[b]Wishlist and follow on Steam[/b] for future updates, and join the [url=https://discord.gg/WGXcnmp]Discord Channel[/url] for a chance to participate in the upcoming beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38628671/fc7bd7361676cc99edf059f115bc93af5d23bca6.png[/img]
